EFFECTIVE
SEPTEMBER 8, 1959
ALOHA AIRLINES
BETWEEN ISLANDS
N5093A
FIRST IN HAWAII
WITH
JET POWER

ONLY
ALOHA
AIRLINES
PROVIDES THE
MODERN CONVENIENCE OF
ALL JET POWER FOR HAWAII
FLY ALOHA'S JETPROP VISCOUNTS AND F-27S
..... AT NO EXTRA FARE
• AIR-CONDITIONED on the ground and in the air
• SMOOTH, QUIETER, vibration-free flying comfort
• ROLLS-ROYCE dependability
Now you can fly between the Islands on the planes specifically designed
to meet Jet Age requirements for short distance flights-Aloha Airlines
JETPROP FOUR-ENGINE VISCOUNTS
and JETPROP F-27s. They were
designed and created to provide the best in JET POWER. Both aircraft
are powered by the famed, smooth-running ROLLS-ROYCE engines, perfect
for just such flights as Aloha's between-the-islands routes. Inside the
pressurized, air-conditioned-refrigerated cabin, you enjoy quieter, smooth.
riding luxury.
Your Aloha stewardess serves you with warm, friendly
courtesy-truly
"Island-style" hospitality.
Refreshments
are served on
every flight and there are many Aloha "extras" to make your flight more
enjoyable. Whether your Neighbor Island trip is for business or pleasure,
fly the finest-and fastest-Aloha Airlines, Hawaii's only ALL JET
POWER service!
